title: Towards Safer AI Moderation: Evaluating LLM Moderators Through a Unified Benchmark Dataset and Advocating a Human-First Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of LLM moderators to classify nuanced sexist text, behavioral expectations, and gender-based stereotypes as 'unsafe' using datasets like 'Call Me Sexist, But' (CMSB) and Social Bias Frames.

Testing LLM moderators on their capacity to flag explicit racial slurs, implicit racist rhetoric, and white supremacist text using prompt-based safety classification on datasets like Stormfront, Slur, and Measuring Hate Speech (MHS).

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Assessing the detection of homophobic and transphobic slurs and derogatory comments by passing instances from categorized slur corpora and human-annotated hate speech datasets to LLM moderation tools.
Measuring the moderation models' performance in identifying religiously offensive content and targeted hostility, such as Islamophobic text, using the HateXplain dataset.
Evaluating the models' capability to flag implicit xenophobic rhetoric and immigrant-targeted hate speech by analyzing prediction accuracy on context-dependent remarks and cultural references.
